study.question: Does the centered rather than the shared occupied-row mean component of auxiliary product-context supervision retain useful click transfer under a common FP64 collection path, and does full transfer still improve on blocked shared transfer?
study.hypothesis: Earlier component trials provisionally favored full/centered over mean/blocked transfer, but the latest reduction controls show effects of precision comparable to or larger than those mechanism contrasts. Under common aggregate FP64 collection, the example-varying centered component C may still supply useful shared-representation learning whereas row-constant M alone is insufficient. This is unverified. Full G=C+M and zero complete the2x2 inclusion factorial. The centered replay is a gate on interpreting the new comparisons; equal AUC alone does not prove numerical equivalence.

nearest_work.difference: Same local row-space decomposition question; now all four endpoints use the three-output collected aggregate FP64 path. The older task-edge/FP32 trajectory is an anchor, not a matched comparison to the new source.

Inherit its entire forward model and three-output collector. Compute G,M,C,zero in all cells, select the returned component, and freeze aggregate FP64. One replay checks whether extra unused component arithmetic perturbs the centered trajectory.

Archived primary text lines250-277 verifies target-conditioned unnormalized local activation. The local baseline and inherited model adapt it to released fields/four tasks; this proposal changes only backward transfer, without asserting reproduction of the original paper.

inherited_components: Complete g3-r0041-collected_aggregate64 forward implementation: masked target-match/order summaries, folded support/Dice populations, task residual adapters and rank16 context-history product correction.
All four heads, private auxiliary updates, true-label joint sum-BCE hook, item/action/scorer gates and auxiliary tower/residual context gates.
Three-output cart/fav/buy context identity collection with original context on click graph; explicit task order, aggregate FP64 promotion and one final dtype cast.
Exact module construction/reset ordering, RNG isolation, buffers, initialization and pruned inference; no new learned capacity.
study.proposed_difference: Let o be history occupancy, n=max(sum(o),1), G=o*((g_cart+g_fav)+g_buy) in FP64, M=o*sum_rows(G)/n, and C=o*(G-sum_rows(G)/n). Return respectively C,G,M,zero at the one existing auxiliary collector boundary, casting once to the incoming dtype. Every variant computes all four tensors; no current labels enter forward. The new component selector is the only cross-variant config/default change. This returns a prescribed first-order VJP for centered/mean/blocked, not the derivative of the identity forward or a new scalar objective. Full is the ordinary sum up to changed accumulation precision. Fixed product-only transfer isolates this path; results do not fully explain the stronger joint model with residual transfer open.
predictions: Preflight: all four variants have identical train/eval probabilities, BCEs, initial parameters/buffers/RNG and private/click gradients at a shared state. Only the auxiliary input-context cotangent changes.

The centered arm should reproduce g3-r0041-collected_aggregate64 (AUC0.6682972490126902) under the same host recipe. Check prediction/checkpoint identity when host artifacts permit; equal rounded AUC is insufficient. A discrepancy reopens execution-integrity investigation.

At the fixed seed, C and G are predicted to beat zero in click AUC; C should beat M. Differences are preliminary full-trajectory observations until admissible paired repetitions and cluster uncertainty are available.
The predeclared2x2 contrasts are C-0 and G-M for centered inclusion, M-0 and G-C for mean inclusion, and interaction G-C-M+0 in AUC units. No additive performance model is assumed.

The four variants should have equal parameter counts and inference graph/cost within measurement noise; FP64 backward components may add training cost over historical FP32, measured rather than assumed.
falsifiers: Any failure of mask/gradient/alias/state invariants invalidates mechanism interpretation and must be recorded as implementation failure, not negative scientific evidence.
A failed centered replay without a discriminating execution explanation prevents pooling older decomposition evidence with these new arms.

C failing to outperform zero and M in reproducible matched comparisons falsifies the proposed useful-centered-transfer explanation within this path/protocol. One fixed-seed failure leaves replication uncertainty.

G failing to beat zero in reproducible matched comparisons falsifies useful full product-path auxiliary transfer here, without refuting auxiliary supervision through other paths or a different architecture.
If M consistently matches/exceeds C, do not claim example-varying centered transfer accounts for the benefit. If removing M harms C relative to G, the claim that M is unnecessary is false.
alternative_explanations: Changing transferred components changes gradient magnitude and subsequent private weights; this study alone cannot separate direction from magnitude.
Row-space decomposition need not remain orthogonal after repeated-feature-ID sparse scatter or Adagrad preconditioning.
Only the collector reduction is FP64; upstream BF16 gradients and downstream embedding accumulation remain as in the frozen host.
Single fixed-seed full trajectories and selection on this validation population limit generalization.
The old full/centered versus mean/blocked ranking may arise from reduction rounding and execution topology rather than a stable transferable mechanism.
Sparse embedding aliasing can send context gradients to tables also used by other fields; source-edge blocking alone does not establish parameter ownership.
Mean transfer can encode batch composition; centering can change popularity/scale or effective regularization rather than resolve task-gradient interference.

Official auxiliary labels are category/brand matches within24h, and official_offline feedback may be immature at prediction time; neither ad-conversion attribution nor production point-in-time validity is established.
